docs.openclank-docs-accounts-models.body:
# Accounts and Models

Sign in to the Open Clank account that owns your chats and journal pages. Connect a model for that account in [Settings](clank://settings) → **Add Provider**.

## Connect a model

- **Local** connects to a model server running at an address Open Clank can reach. See [[Compare and Cookbook]] for serving a downloaded model.
- **API** takes a supported endpoint and its credential. The provider’s API quota and billing apply.
- **Subscription** uses a sign-in method offered by the provider. Model availability follows that account’s entitlements.

If **Provider login** is waiting, choose **Open current sign-in**. Enter the **Sign-in code** if offered. For manual callbacks, use the authorization-code field and **Complete login** on the original flow. Return to **Add Provider** or **Model Management** to resume an unfinished sign-in. Use **Cancel login** to abandon it. If the result is unclear, check Model Management before starting again.

## Check the inventory and use the route

In [Model Management](clank://settings/added-models), expand the connection and check **Models**. An empty list can mean the local server is unreachable, the API credential or endpoint needs correction, or the subscription still needs sign-in under **Account & advanced**. Use **Refresh models** after correcting it. A failed refresh can leave the last known list visible.

Select an available model in Chat. Its response label and [[Usage and Stats|Usage]] show which model answered. Switching models keeps the chat intact.

On the connection, **Disable** pauses the route and **Delete** removes the connection and its accounts. Use **Remove** on an individual account to detach it. On eligible models, **Share** lets you choose or remove named recipients. Models shared with you appear in Model Management.
docs.openclank-docs-chat-workspaces.body:
# Chat and Workspaces

Open [Chat](clank://chat), choose a saved chat or start a new one, and select a model. Attach files in the composer. For work in a Host folder, select the workspace and check its name before enabling **Shell Access**. Workspace rules, file permissions and individual approvals still apply. See [[Workspace Hexes]] and [[App Windows and Navigation]].

## Send or steer a follow-up

Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a new line. During a reply, Enter normally steers the turn and Ctrl+Enter queues a new message. Change this in **Settings → AI Defaults → Chat input → Queue follow-ups by default**. Pending messages above the composer offer **Send now** and **Cancel** where available. Choose **Stop** to stop the active turn.

## See what the chat is using

In a saved workspace chat, open **Workspace**. **Changes** lists observed workspace edits. **Sources** shows attached files and sources from loaded messages. Use **+** to attach a workspace file or select a source card to open it.

Open **Sources → Model context** or the context meter. The meter can show an estimate for current context and a reported size for the last request. **Inspect provider frames** shows retained sources and model details by attempt, with gaps labeled. If offered, **Preview** a context selection before choosing **Apply selection**. See [[Agent Settings and Compaction]] and [[Usage and Stats]].

## Inspect a worker or a saved plan

Open **Workspace → Subagents** and select a worker to see its session, observations and available transcript. Use **Send follow-up** to address that worker when enabled. **Chat work** lists recorded commitments, executions and routines. Open a pending question or approval in the originating chat or worker.

In a chat with a saved plan, open the plan panel’s **Feedback**. Check the revision, save your comment, then choose **Send** or **Verify and send** to deliver it. See [[Tasks and Continuations]] for scheduled follow-through.

## Resume, fork or recover

Use **Chats** or `/sessions` to find a conversation and `/resume name` to open it. For a supported native chat, use `/timeline` to find a mapped user message. `/fork <host-message-id>` opens a separate continuation before it. `/recover` lists supported interrupted replies and gives the command to recover one. Reconcile a pending fork receipt before retrying. Type `/commands` for the browser command list.

## Preview or move work

Select **Preview saved HTML** on an eligible tool result. The preview lists dependency gaps and offers **Open in Editor**, **Export source bundle (partial static)** and **Widget state…** where available. Use **More → Copy Chat** for chat text or [[Search and Media#Keep or export an output|Review selected outputs]] for saved files.

In Files, select an eligible standalone Codex thread-history SQLite snapshot and choose **Preview selected history…**. Choose an **Owned workspace**, then **Preview threads → Open thread**. Select supported items starting with a user message. Enter a **New chat name**, then **Review import → Import selected**. **Open imported chat** opens the new chat for model selection. If the result is unclear, use **Reconcile import** or save the recovery selector for **File → Recover previous history import…** under the same account.

## Continue from a terminal

With the Open Clank CLI installed, open a saved browser chat and copy its ID from `/chats info`. Substitute your server URL and chat ID below.

```bash
openclank profile add work https://clank.example --use
openclank login --profile work
openclank run --profile work --session CHAT_ID --prompt "Summarize the decisions so far."
openclank tui --profile work
openclank logout --profile work
```

Approve the terminal in the browser. Use `--no-browser` to open the displayed URL yourself. The profile selects the server and `--session` selects its chat. In TUI, type `open` and a number from **Sessions**. Use `help` for commands and `quit` before `logout` revokes the credential. Without an OS credential vault, open TUI directly and authorize it for that process.
docs.openclank-docs-editor.body:
# Editor

Keep a source file, its reference image and your notes open in the same Editor. An image tab brings its own canvas, layers and history. Text tabs bring back your writing tools. Use **Text**, **Wiki** and **Graph** on Editor’s left rail to return to your files, read linked pages or follow their connections.

## Explore the workspace

**Explorer** is Editor’s file sidebar. With no folder selected it shows the places you can browse. Open a file to focus its workspace, or use **File → Open folder…** to pin a particular folder. Opening another tab keeps that folder in view. **Close Folder** returns to available places. The [[Journal]] shortcut opens your own writing workspace; the Instruction Manual opens its read-only examples.

## Source comments

In supported source files, native comments render Markdown, including images. Click a comment to edit the prose in place. Open its context menu and choose **See source** to edit the raw comment. Leaving the inset updates the draft. **Save** writes the change to the source file. See [[Source Editing]] for syntax selection and conflicts when another program edits the same file.

## Open and arrange work

Split a tab right or below from its menu to keep the reference beside the work. While **Text** is active, select its button to hide or reopen Explorer. **Details** follows the active document.

## Save, Undo and close

Editor and Wiki share a page’s draft and Undo history. If the disk copy changes while your draft is dirty, compare the revisions before reloading. See [[Recovery]] for an uncertain save.

## Media and source reveal

[[OpenClank/Files and Imps#Image projects in Editor|Keep an image’s layers]], [[Deliverables|review a recording or export a deck]], or select a rendered example in [[Markdown Formatting Demo]] to see its underlying Markdown.
docs.openclank-docs-files-imps.body:
# Files and image editing

Open an image from [Files](clank://files) to work on it alongside your text tabs in [[Editor]]. Files keeps its own location while Editor’s file sidebar follows the workspace you opened.

## Image projects in Editor

Crop or paint on the canvas, or choose **+ Import** to add another image as a layer. Layers and History belong to the active image. Pick the output by what you’ll need later:

| What you want | File menu |
| --- | --- |
| Reopen the layers for another edit | **Export layered project…**; reopen with **Import image project…** |
| Give someone the finished picture | **Download PNG** |
| Save a second image in Files | **Save as copy…** |
| Update the writable original | **Save file** |

**Open image draft…** resumes a retained edit. If the original has changed, keep your working copy and see [[Recovery]].

## Browse and open

Select saved HTML and choose **Open in Browser** for its preview. On a source folder, **Open in Code Graph** follows the saved files; on a file it starts with the containing folder. Missing host folders can be registered under [File access](clank://settings/file-access).

**Invite / manage access…** grants access inside the app. **Share download…** creates a download link. Choose a snapshot for a fixed version or a current-file link for subsequent changes. Revoke a link under **Manage shared downloads…**.

## Windows, split panes and views

Split a Files window right or below to keep the source and destination visible. Each pane has independent navigation. In a drag between panes, hold Option on macOS or Control on Windows/Linux to copy instead of moving. **Keep Both** retries a name collision with a new name.

## Create a file in Files

**File → New file…** creates the file in a writable destination. Choose **Open** in the receipt to go straight to Editor. For a personal [[Journal|journal page]], start in the journal workspace.

docs.openclank-docs-formatting-demo.body:
# Markdown Formatting Demo

Click a rendered block on this page to reveal or copy its Markdown. **Back to rendered** shows the result again.

## Task list

- [x] Mark the region in the reference image.
- [ ] Send the selected frame to the original chat.

## Quote

> Put the diagram beside the code that uses it.

## Emphasis and marks

Keep the **source**, mark the *draft*, cross out ~~superseded values~~ and ==highlight the change==.

## Table

| Keep editing | Share a copy |
| --- | --- |
| Layered image project | PNG |
| Workbook or slide deck | PDF |

## Links and references

[[Editor]] opens a manual page. [Settings](clank://settings) opens a control in the app. [[Wiki Recipes]] includes a live section embed.

## Code

```markdown
![[OpenClank/Editor#Source comments]]
```

## Footnote-style note

A source can stay beside its claim.[^source]

[^source]: Keep the version you used with the page.
docs.openclank-docs-getting-work-done.bo:
# Getting Work Done

Suppose an agent drew the wrong part of a reference image. Instead of describing “the thing in the corner,” open the saved image in [[Editor]], select the region and choose **File → Feedback on image region…**. The original chat receives a draft with the file revision and the region. Add the correction, review the recipient and send. [[Deliverables]] shows the same workflow for a chart, slide or moment in a recording.

Working on source? Give [[Chat and Workspaces|the chat a working folder]]. Open saved changes in [[Graph]] to follow a call back to its definition. If the next step belongs to you, keep it in [[Tasks and Continuations|Meatbag Tasks]]; if it should run later, schedule a Clanker Task.
docs.openclank-docs-graph.body:
# Graph

Open [Graph](clank://graph) from the Editor rail. In **Graph view**, choose **Journal & Wiki** to follow page links or **Code** to follow relationships in saved source code.

![Editor activity rail → Graph → Graph view. Journal & Wiki uses saved workspace pages and links. For Code, use File → Open folder… to select an authorized code folder, then expand a file to load symbols.](/static/docs/media/manual-graph-source-scope/preview.webp)

*Graph source diagram. Inspect saved links in Journal & Wiki. In Code, check index coverage before interpreting a gap in the graph.*

## Find a useful view

Filter by folder, kind, tag or property. Clear filters if the view is empty. Use **Structure** for a page outline and **Galaxy** for document and calendar relationships. For dated events, open [Timeline](clank://timeline).

## Try a small graph

Create **Field Notes** and **Reading List** in the same [[Journal]]. Add `[[Reading List]]` to Field Notes and save it. In **Journal & Wiki**, select the Reading List node linked to Field Notes to open that page. See [[Wiki Recipes]] for more link and embed examples.

## Code Graph

1. In Graph, choose **File → Open folder…** and select an authorized Host folder. Graph switches to Code. From Files or Editor, **Open in Code Graph** takes one supported file or folder. Confirm the containing folder if you started from a file.
2. In an Open Clank checkout, wait for indexing and open **View → Search & evidence**. Under **Indexed metadata**, find `atomic_write_text` in `core/atomic_io.py`. Select the declaration and choose **Show in graph**. Use **Source contents · literal** to find case-sensitive text in saved, indexed files.
3. Choose **Graph → Connections for selected item**. With **Calls** visible, choose **Trace from selection** in Inspector and select `atomic_write_bytes` as the endpoint. Choose **Open witness** to read the saved call site. Use **View → Graph table** for a text view.

### Expand a large folder

**Gravity** is the default for a new view. **Web** shows a network and **Map** a compact strip. In Editor’s Explorer sidebar, select a folder and use **Graph → Expand selected branch**. Choose **Load more for selected branch** if more results are available. Use **Hide selected branch children** to clear space.

In **View → Graph settings…**, choose **Gravity override** for a change specific to Gravity or **Common defaults** for all layouts.

| What you need | Where to adjust it |
| --- | --- |
| Load more of a branch | **Paging & expansion** controls read size and depth. |
| Keep or show more of what is loaded | **Map cache** bounds what Graph retains. **Display capacity** bounds what it draws. Check **Effective capacity** for the limits in use. |
| Include more source files | **Settings → System → Code indexing** sets file and byte limits. |
| Make a crowded view readable | Use **Labels & relationships** to isolate calls or imports and **Motion & camera** to reduce animation. Save grouping and spacing under **Named physics settings**. |

### Resolve a partial or stale graph

Folder structure can appear before symbol evidence is ready. If a branch is missing, check **View → Coverage and diagnostics** for index coverage, then clear filters or load more. After a source save, use **Graph → Refresh now** if the old view is still showing. Use **Retry indexing** or **Readmit erased index** when offered.

### Review and share evidence

Open a call witness for the saved source behind a static edge. Inferred edges reflect source rules. **Recorded changes** shows observed file activity, and eligible static-function views can open **Imported trace evidence**. Open a trace there to inspect the observations it contains.

Choose **Add selected evidence to chat** to put it in the draft or **Ask about selected evidence** to send a question. In **Search & evidence**, use **Summarize selected evidence → Preview** to review the source scope and model before generating. Check the finished summary against its source links. To save a fact for future recall, see [[Memory and Lore]].

Use **File → Export current graph…** to preview the displayed graph and omissions. Choose a format and **Save**, or **Create new wiki document…** when offered. Reopen the preview if the graph changes.

## Official pages

Use **Include official documentation** to show handbook pages.
docs.openclank-docs-home.body:
# Open Clank

Open Clank is a self-hosted AI workspace for turning ideas into finished work. Your personal agent works with your notes and files from day one.

[[Journal|Copal]] is an open-source alternative to Obsidian. Its built-in [[Editor|file editor]] handles text, code and images. [[Graph]] maps links between journal pages, dependencies in your workspace and the files your notes refer to.

Learn in [[TreeHouse]], a pre-alpha learning management suite. Track milestones on [Timeline](clank://timeline), [[Tasks and Continuations|schedule tasks]] and [[Calendar and Email|sync your calendar]].

docs.openclank-docs-limits.body:
# Limits and Platform Support

Check your exact package and checksum. [Beta 2 release and artifact records](https://github.com/Plaer1/open-clank/releases/tag/v1.0.3-beta.2).

| Platform | Support |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Apple Silicon package for macOS 15 or later. Ad-hoc signed. |
| Windows | Use an architecture offered by the release. Installed-package checks are recorded per artifact. |
| Linux | Source setup is documented. App and package qualification remain open. |
| Docker | Legacy files. Unsupported. |

For installation steps see [[Setup and First Run]]. For source and package evidence see the [known limits](https://github.com/Plaer1/open-clank/blob/main/docs/known-limits.md).

## What depends on my installation?

- **Host actions** depend on OS access and available handlers. See [[Desktop Capture and Host Opening]].
- [[Graph|Code Graph]] shows the evidence for each indexed relationship. Check coverage when a call or dependency is missing.
- **Remote services** receive the material you send and may charge for requests. Model and provider capabilities vary. See [[Accounts and Models]].
- **Journal** uses Files-backed storage in the current hosted app. Preserve older stores using the upgrade and backup guides before switching. See [[Recovery]].

The service runs within its host OS account’s permissions. A link follows the reader’s existing grants. [Deployment security](https://github.com/Plaer1/open-clank/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

docs.openclank-docs-memory-lore.body:
# Memory and Lore

| If you need… | Open… |
| --- | --- |
| What was said or which tools ran | The original chat or transcript |
| A fact or preference the assistant can recall | [Memery](clank://memory) |
| Reported or estimated token counts | [[Usage and Stats]] |
| An earlier state of a file | The project's or document's History |

## Semantic memory

To save a preference, open **Memery → Add → Add Memory**, type it, select a category and press Enter. If it goes to review, open **Inspect → Candidates → Pending**. Check the wording and source, then **Edit**, **Promote**, or **Reject**. Promoted entries appear under **Curated**. Other profiles save the entry directly in **Memories**.

In **Inspect**, **Raw trajectory** shows captured evidence, **History** shows revisions, and **Quarantined** shows items withheld from recall. For eligible pending additions, use **Select for atomic batch** to preview and approve several together. If the result is unknown, choose **Check original status**.

To correct an outdated claim, open the newer item in **Memories → … → Details → Review relationship**. Choose the earlier item or **Find suggested pairs**. Use **Compare evidence** to read both claims and their sources. Choose **Preview supersession → Confirm supersession** or **Decline pair**. **Detach** removes a confirmed link while keeping both histories.

## Review an import batch

Use **Add → Add Memory → Import** to select files. When processing finishes, open **review** on the banner in **Memories**. Check suggestions against their sources and edit, save or reject each one. Use **check import status** for files that need attention.

Use **Export as Markdown** for one file or **Export as Markdown files (zip)** for separate files in a ZIP. When you import an Open Clank Markdown export, the text goes through review.

## Move reviewed knowledge

1. From a memory's **…** menu, choose **Export knowledge snapshot…**. Preview the full text and category before **Confirm and download**. For several memories, use **Select → Export selected as snapshots…** and check the included count.
2. In the receiving account, choose **Add → Add Memory → Import snapshot…** or **Import snapshot bundle…**. Use **Preview** for a single file or **Start import** for a bundle. Read the text and category and choose **Create review draft** for each item you want.
3. In **Memories → review**, decide which drafts to retain. Inspect skipped or refused bundle items and preview again if the bytes change. Check the original status for an unknown outcome.

For a saved folder analysis, choose **Check original files** on the memory. Select the original Host folder under its owned workspace. **Compare saved snapshot** reports the result for each component, including any it could not verify.

## Skills, prompts and admission

1. Open **Add → Add Skill → Marketplace…** and choose an offered source. Select **Preview catalog → View components → Review skill** for the skill you want. Review the publisher, release and files before **Create draft**.
2. In **Skills**, open the draft, read the instructions and companion files, then **Publish** to make it available. **Settings → Inject Skills** controls how many relevant skills can join a request. Zero turns off automatic injection.
3. In chat, expand **Skill used: …** to see the loaded revision and files when a receipt is available. To withdraw a skill, choose **Unpublish** on its card.

To move a published skill, use **Export snapshot…**, preview its contents and download it. Use **Add Skill → Import snapshot…** in the receiving account to review and create an independent draft.

## Timeline and Graph

**Memery → Graph** shows memory relationships. [[Graph]] follows links between journal pages or saved source. For an open chat, **Inspect → Journal coverage** shows chat consolidation progress. On a synthesis candidate, use **Review Journal sources → Open source chat** to review its citations. Open [[Journal]] for personal pages.

## Lore and recovery

Use the document's or project's **History** to inspect earlier file states before restoring. See [[Recovery]] for file restoration and pending operations.

**Settings → Nuke my Brain data** previews removal of selected live Memery data. Review the chosen categories and result. Source files, exports and backups are retained separately.

docs.openclank-docs-recovery.body:
# Recovery

Keep your draft until you know what was saved.

| Problem | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| Save conflict | Reopen the stored revision and merge your draft. |
| Save refused because a recovery version is unavailable | Restore the recovery service before retrying. |
| Editor cannot read a document | Inspect the preserved source or restore an earlier version. Preserve the original bytes. |
| Missing file or media | Check the account and **Permissions → Your file access**. Relink a moved resource or replace an expired link with a saved file. |
| Unsure whether an external action finished | Check the original result or receipt before repeating the action. |
| Handbook page changed | Reopen it from Help for the current edition. Your personal notes stay in their own documents. |
| Missing sidebar shortcut | Restore it in **Settings → Appearance → Copal navigation**. |

## Restore a file or project

Select the file, then choose **Actions → History** to review its versions or checkpoints. For an open Host folder, choose **Go → Folder History…** and open a file’s versions from the recorded changes or **Removed files**. Review the selected version before confirming a restore. See [[Memory and Lore]].

## Restore an installation

The repository backup helper covers its `data/` directory. Check for Journal storage, host workspaces and other stores outside that directory. **Settings → System → Data Backup** transfers the listed user-data categories as JSON. For full restore steps and coverage, use the [backup guide](https://github.com/Plaer1/open-clank/blob/main/docs/backup-restore.md).

docs.openclank-docs-settings-themes.body:
# Settings and Themes

Use **Find a setting…** to jump to a control. Theme and keyboard bindings are browser-local. Provider connections and launcher visibility belong to your account. [Settings](clank://settings).

## Files, Editor and agent access

**Permissions → Your file access** shows what you can open in Files and Editor. Administrators share a **Location** through **People**, with **Browse / download** or **Modify** access. **Operation approvals** shows saved agent approvals and when they expire.

The owner and administrators can set **Permissions → Full filesystem access** for their own accounts. **Files and Editor** and **Agents for this account** are separate switches. On uses the host OS account’s permissions. Off uses existing folder grants. **Account → Full access** enables models and optional tools where offered.

## Account and administration

Set up your authenticator under **Account → Two-Factor Authentication**. For a provider login, see [[Accounts and Models]]. Administrators manage scoped API tokens at `/api/tokens`.

Check **Logging → Storage inventory**, or use the administrator’s **System → Stack health**, **Terminal Logs** and **Data Backup**. For what backups cover, see [[Recovery#Restore an installation|Restore an installation]].

**Tokenomics** lets you opt into changes such as reusing exact repeated Browser snapshot text. Check the effective settings there and observed usage under [[Usage and Stats]].

## Connect an MCP tool server

As an administrator, open **Settings → Integrations → MCP Tool Server**. Select **stdio** for a command, arguments and environment on the host, or **SSE** or **Streamable HTTP** for a server URL. Put credentials in the connection settings. Choose **Save**, complete **Authorize** if prompted and check the tool list. A local command uses the host’s access. A remote tool receives the data you pass to it.

## Change appearance

Open [Appearance](clank://settings/appearance). Choose **Solid** to stop background motion. **Copal navigation** restores a hidden Journal shortcut. [Shortcuts](clank://settings/shortcuts) shows your bindings.

New supported workbooks and decks use the current theme. To change an existing one, see [[Deliverables#Edit a slide deck|Apply the current theme]]. **Reduce motion in generated deliverables** is an account preference.

## Google Emoji Drift artwork

Select **Emoji Drift** to review consent. Regular emoji appear immediately and give way to downloaded artwork as it arrives. **Allow** permits acquisition. Choose **Refresh artwork status** under Emoji Drift to see download and update progress, pause or resume weekly updates, or **Revoke emoji artwork consent**. See [[Credits and Included Components]].
docs.openclank-docs-tasks.body:
# Tasks and Continuations

Open [Tasks](clank://tasks). **Meatbag Tasks** holds work you follow through on. **Clanker Tasks** runs model work on a schedule or on demand. **Workload** shows the commitments, executions and routines the current scope recorded.

## Track your own work

In **Meatbag Tasks**, create an item, check its title, source and due date, and mark it complete when done. A page checklist stays in the page until you use an explicit task action that creates an item in Tasks.

## Schedule or continue model work

In **Clanker Tasks → New Task**, set the prompt, model, schedule and output destination. Verify access to that destination. A task with email delivery can send to the saved address. Save and check the next-run time, or use **Run now**.

Use the task log to inspect or stop the current run. **History** shows prior output or errors. Check the previous outcome before retrying a task that can send or modify something. **Pause** and **Resume** control its schedule.

In Chat, ask explicitly for a task when the work needs its own schedule or record. Open the resulting task chat to answer its question. Follow an existing worker from **Workload** or [[Chat and Workspaces#Inspect a worker or a saved plan|the chat’s worker view]].

## Review repository changes

Open the repository root in Files and select its managed chat. Choose **Files → Go → Git workbench…** to see working and staged changes. Choose a file if required, select a **Git operation**, then use **Review** to inspect the saved bytes and target before confirming. If the result is pending, use **Check status**. See [[Recovery]] for file history.

treehouse.lesson.house-collaborate.chat-:
Fungua [Chat](clank://chat) na utume ujumbe mmoja. Badilisha hadi nafasi ya kazi tofauti (au fungua mradi tofauti), kisha rudi kwenye orodha ya gumzo na ufungue upya gumzo lile lile. Nakala kamili ipo na kikao ni kile kile.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** gumzo hufunguka upya na utambulisho ule ule wa kikao na zamu za awali bado zikionekana. Kufungua somo hauanzishi mwito wa mfano; kutuma ujumbe ndicho kitendo cha kulipwa na daima ni chako kutuma.

Gumzo limefungwa kwa utambulisho wa kikao, si kwa folda uliyokuwa ukiiangalia. Badilisha nafasi ya kazi na gumzo linaishikilia kitambulisho chake cha kikao na nakala. Muktadha wa kazi hubadilika; gumzo haligeuki kimyakimya kuwa tofauti.
Hakuna cha kufuta. Gumzo ni gumzo lako la kawaida.
Gumzo lile lile hufunguka upya na zamu zake za awali baada ya kubadilisha nafasi ya kazi.
Tuma ujumbe mmoja tu, kisha badilisha nafasi ya kazi na ufungue upya gumzo hili.
Gumzo la mazoezi la ujumbe mmoja
Gumzo lile lile lililofunguliwa upya katika nafasi tofauti ya kazi, bado likitambulika kuwa lake.
Gumzo linaloishikilia utambulisho wake nafasi ya kazi inapobadilika

Hiki ndicho kinachofanya kuipanga kazi katika nafasi za kazi kuwa salama bila kupoteza uzi wa mazungumzo. Maswali yako ya kufuatilia bado hufika katika gumzo lile lile, na jibu bado linaelewa kilichotangulia.
treehouse.lesson.house-collaborate.durab:
Fungua [Chat](clank://chat) kwenye kikao na uunde lengo lenye hitaji halisi — kwa mfano, "zalisha muhtasari na uunge kama hati." Fanya kazi kulifikia. Kazi inapokamilika, thibitisha lengo; uthibitisho unahitaji utambulisho wa lengo na marekebisho pamoja na ushahidi ulioataja.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** lengo hufikia hali iliyothibitishwa imekamilika na marejeo yake ya ushahidi yameridhika. Kauli ya mfano peke yake haliwezi kulikamilisha.

Lengo endelevu ni zaidi ya jambo la kufanya. Linarekodi kinachopaswa kuwa kweli, na kulikamilisha kunahitaji ushahidi ulioomba — si mfano kusema "imekamilika." Malengo hukaa pamoja na kikao na hupita zamu iliyoyaunda.
Kamilisha au ondoa lengo kwa kawaida; ni hali ya kawaida ya kikao.
Lengo linaonyesha hali iliyothibitishwa imekamilika na marejeo ya ushahidi yameandikwa.
Tengeneza lengo moja ambalo ukamilishaji wake unahitaji hati au kifaa kilichotajwa kama ushahidi.
Lengo linalobeba hitaji lake la uthibitisho kabla halijaongwa kuwa limekamilika.
Hii ndiyo tofauti kati ya kazi inayoonekana imekamilika na kazi unayoweza kuihakiki. Lengo linapoomba ushahidi, uthibitisho ni wako kukagua, si dai la kuamini.
treehouse.lesson.house-collaborate.menme:
Fungua [Memery](clank://memory) na ukague mgombea anayesubiri — kubali unayemhitaji kweli. Kisha tafuta rekodi na uifungue. Kwa upande mwingine, fungua historia ya hati na uangalie toleo zilizoshikiliwa; zile ni nyenzo za Lore.

Mipaka ya uwekaji hifadhi iko kwenye [Mipangilio → Historia](clank://settings/history). Kile kisichoshikiliwa hakiwezi kurejeshwa.

**Memery** ni upande wa pembeni ambapo kumbukumbu hukaa: wagombea wanaosubiri ukaguzi wako, na utafutaji juu ya uliyohifadhi. Unamkubali mgombea kwa uwazi; hakuna kinachoandikwa nyuma yako. **Lore** ni urejeshaji: toleo zilizoshikiliwa za kazi yako na risiti zinazokuachia uzipate upya.
Zana mbili tofauti, zinazotumika kwa kazi mbili tofauti.
Ukaguzi wa Memery na ukumbusho dhidi ya urejeshaji wa Lore

Kuchanganya hizo mbili hupoteza muda. Memery hujibu "msaidizi anajua nini kuhusu mimi?" Lore hujibu "namna gani ya kupata toleo la jana?" Ukaguzi ni kuhusu wakati ujao; kurejesha ni kuhusu wakati uliopita.
treehouse.lesson.house-collaborate.model:
Fungua [Mipangilio → Watoa Huduma](clank://settings/providers) na utambue modeli ipi ni Modeli ya Gumzo ya Chaguo-Msingi. Kisha fungua [Chat](clank://chat) na uandike muhtasari wa jambo unalohitaji kweli: taja matokeo, hadhira na kizuizi kimoja. Kitume kwenye uliyochagua.

**Kilicho cha kipekee:** modeli ni mpangilio wa akaunti, si siri ya jumla. Watoa huduma unaowaongeza ni wako; paneli ile ile ya mipangilio inaonyesha waliosanidiwa.

Modeli husanidiwa kwa kila akaunti katika [Mipangilio → Watoa Huduma](clank://settings/providers). Modeli ya Gumzo ya Chaguo-Msingi ndiyo gumzo jipya hutumia; Utafiti wa Kina na kazi nyingine maalum zinaweza kuirithi au kuweka zao. Mtoa huduma ni huduma nyuma ya modeli — ongeza moja na modeli zake hufanywa kuchaguliwa.
Gumzo lililofunguliwa na uliyochagua na muhtasari unaotaja matokeo unayotaka.
Modeli zinazotambua akaunti na muhtasari wa manufaa

Kuchagua modeli kwa makusudi ni tofauti kati ya rasimu ya bei nafuu na ukaguzi wa makini. Muhtasari unaotaja matokeo, hadhira na vizuizi hukupa kazi ya manufaa katika zamu ya kwanza badala ya duru tatu za kufafanua.
treehouse.lesson.house-collaborate.sched:
Fungua [Meatbag Tasks](clank://tasks) na uunde ukumbusho wa mazoezi uliopangwa. Kagua mzigo wake na hali ya uendeshaji. Ukikimbia, fungua gumzo lake la kazi na uthibitisho jibu liko hapo.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** uendeshaji hutoa risiti iliyohifadhiwa na jibu linaonekana katika gumzo lake la kazi. Kuunda ratiba bila uendeshaji uliofanikiwa hauhesabiwi kama kazi iliyokamilika.

Unaweza kuweka clanker kwenye ratiba. Kazi iliyopangwa inapoendeshwa, jibu lake hurudi kwenye gumzo la kazi asilia — si kwa gumzo lolote lililo wazi. Utambulisho wa kazi huishikiliwa ili maswali ya kufuatilia yafike pale kazi ilipo.
Ghairi ukumbusho kama haukutaki uendelee; kughairi ni salama na kuna uwezekano wa kubatilisha.
Kazi inaonyesha mzigo wake na aidha risiti ya uendeshaji iliyohifadhiwa au hali ya kughairi uliyochagua.
Tengeneza ukumbusho wa mazoezi wa mara moja na uchague mzigo wake uliopangwa kabla haujaendeshwa.
Kazi iliyopangwa ambayo matokeo yake hufika kwenye gumzo linalomiliki kazi hiyo.
Kazi zilizopangwa na kujibu katika gumzo lake la kazi asilia
Otomatiki ni ya manufaa tu pato lake likipatikana. Matokeo yanayojibu katika gumzo la kazi huishikilia risiti, nakala na ufuatiliaji wako mahali pamoja.
treehouse.lesson.house-collaborate.tool-:
Fungua [Upatikanaji wa faili](clank://settings/file-access) na usome kinachoruhusiwa. Kisha fungua gumzo ambapo msaidizi alitumia zana na upanue shughuli za zana kwa zamu hiyo.

**Kilicho cha kipekee:** ruhusa ni mpangilio unaoeweza kusomwa, na shughuli ni rekodi unayoweza kuikagua. Hakuna iliyofichwa kwenye maandishi ya jibu.

Ufikiaji wa msaidizi umepewa mipaka na mipangilio ya wazi. [Upatikanaji wa faili](clank://settings/file-access) unataja kinachoweza kusoma na kuandika; shughuli za zana katika gumzo zinaonyesha kilichoendeshwa kweli. Mamlaka hupewa mapema, si kubuniwa katikati ya kazi.
Picha wazi ya kinachoweza kuguswa na msaidizi na kile alichofanya hivi sasa.
Kukagua shughuli za zana na mamlaka yaliyopo
Kujua mipaka kabla ya kuamini hutoa mshangao kwenye faili zako. Na kitu kikiendeshwa, rekodi ya shughuli ndiyo jinsi unavyoikagua — bila kukisia kutoka kwa jibu la maandishi.
treehouse.lesson.house-connections.bases:
Fungua Base katika [Editor](clank://editor). Ongeza thamani iliyopewa aina kwenye safu ya mazoezi na uendeshe mwonekano.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** thamani iliyopewa aina hurejeshwa na hoja ya Base. Maandishi yanayoonekana tu kama hali si thamani iliyopewa aina.

Bases ni hoja hai juu ya maudhui ya hati yaliyopewa aina. Fungua Base katika [Editor](clank://editor) na hukagua kikundi cha kichujio dhidi ya sifa za hati zako — thamani za hali, mada, tarehe — na kurejesha safu zinazolingana zinapobadilika.
Futa safu au hati ya mazoezi ukimaliza.
Hoja ya Base hurejesha safu kwenye thamani yake ya hali iliyopewa aina.
Base inayouliza thamani zilizopewa aina na kurejesha safu zinazolingana.
Bases juu ya maudhui yaliyopewa aina
Base ni mwonekano ambao hukuhitaji kuudhibiti. Thamani ikipewa aina, hoja ni halisi; safu ikibadilika, mwonekano tayari umesasishwa.
treehouse.lesson.house-connections.filte:
Katika mwonekano wa [Graph](clank://graph) uliojaa, tumia kichujio kinachotaja kipengele na thamani kutoka orodha iliyozalishwa ya vipengele, na uthibitisho kikundi cha matokeo kibadilika. Kisha tumia ishara za kamera kupanua na kusogeza.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** kichujio hukibadilisha kikundi cha matokeo, na ishara za kamera zilizokubaliwa hubadilisha kipimo kwa angalau 20% na kusogeza angalau 48 pixel za CSS kutoka kwa kamera ya kuanzia.

Vichujio vya Graph ni vipengele vya programu — folda, lebo na thamani za sifa zinazotokana na maktaba ya sasa — si makadirio ya maandishi ya bure. Udhibiti wa kamera hukuachia kupanua na kusogeza mwonekano uliojaa; udhibiti ni ishara za kawaida zenye athari halisi.
Kikundi cha matokeo hubadilika na kamera husogea umbali halisi.
Tumia kichujio kimoja cha kipengele/thamani kilichozalishwa kwenye mwonekano wa Graph uliojaa.
Mwonekano wa Graph uliochujwa na kamera uliyosogeza kweli.
Vichujio vya programu na udhibiti wa kamera katika Graph
Vichujio ndivyo nyumba kubwa hukaa inayoweza kutembelewa. Udhibiti wa kamera ndivyo unavyosoma eneo moja la grafu kwa ukaribu badala ya kuangalia yote kwa mbali.
treehouse.lesson.house-connections.graph:
Fungua [Graph](clank://graph) kwenye maktaba yenye hati angalau mbili zilizounganishwa. Tazama **Hati · viungo**, kisha badilisha hadi **Muundo · vichwa na vidokezo**.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** hali zote mbili zinaonyesha angalau nodi moja halisi. Kuchagua hali mbili tupu haitoshi.

[Graph](clank://graph) ina hali mbili za hati. **Hati · viungo** huchora uhusiano kati ya hati. **Muundo · vichwa na vidokezo** huchora umbo ndani yake. Galaxy ni makadirio ya tatu ya hiari kwa nyimbo na matukio — mahali pa kuhusika, si mbadala wa yoyote. (Jina la zamani, Mind, lilirejelea hali ya muundo; si kizinduliwa tofauti.)
Hali zote mbili za Graph zinaonyesha angalau nodi moja halisi kutoka kwa maktaba ya mazoezi.
Hati mbili zilizounganishwa zenye kichwa kimoja kila moja, kisha tazama hali zote mbili za Graph.
Hali zote mbili za Graph zimewekwa kwenye maudhui halisi, kila moja ikionyesha angalau nodi moja halisi.
Graph: hali ya hati zilizounganishwa dhidi ya hali ya muundo
Viungo hukuambia kinachohusika; muundo hukuambia hati imetengenezwa na nini. Kubadilisha kati yao ndivyo unavyopata uhusiano unaokosekana kisha upate sehemu inayopaswa kuushikilia.
treehouse.lesson.house-connections.links:
Katika [Editor](clank://editor), tengeneza kiungo kutoka hati moja hadi hati tofauti. Kifuatilie. Kwenye lengo, fungua kiungo cha nyuma na ukifuatilie nyumbani.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** kiungo na uchunguzi wake hufika kwenye hati tofauti, na utambulisho wa chanzo na lengo unalingana na uhusiano.
Hati hujenga viungo kati yao kwa marejeleo ya kawaida. Kufuata kiungo hukua uhusiano hadi hati halisi; lengo linaonyesha kiungo cha nyuma. Graph hutumia uhusiano ule ule kama muundo unaoonekana.
Futa hati zote mbili za mazoezi na kiungo ukimaliza.
Uchunguzi hukua uhusiano hadi hati nyingine yenye utambulisho unaolingana.
Hati A inaunganisha kwenye Hati B; fuata uhusiano pande zote mbili.
Kiungo kilichofuatiliwa hadi lengo lake na kiungo cha nyuma kilichofuatiliwa nyumbani.
Uchunguzi wa kiungo na kiungo cha nyuma
Viungo vya nyuma ndivyo dokezo linavyogeuka kuwa mtandao. Kiungo unachoachia kwenye hati ndicho njia mtu mwingine — au wewe wa baadaye — anayofuata kurudi.
treehouse.lesson.house-connections.resea:
Fungua dokezo la utafiti na uhakiki madai yake yana marejeo ya vyanzo. Fungua matokeo ya Linganisha na usome uteuzi ulioandikwa na sababu.

**Kilicho cha kipekee:** vyanzo hubaki vimeambatishwa na dai, na ulinganisho huacha rekodi badala ya hisia. Ufahamu wa hai ni hiari — majibu ya fixture yaliyorekodiwa yanatosha kujifunza mtiririko, na kusoma somo hili hauanzishi mwito wa kulipwa.

Kazi ya utafiti huishikilia vyanzo vyake. Dokezo la utafiti linaandika kilichotoka wapi, ili dai liweze kuhakikiwa. Linganisha huweka majibu mawili yaliyorekodiwa bega kwa bega na kurekodi uliyochagua na kwa nini. Vyote ni maudhui ya kawaida unayoweza kufungua tena.
Dokezo la utafiti ambalo madai yake yanaweza kufuatiliwa hadi vyanzo, na matokeo ya Linganisha yanayorekodi kwa nini.
Madokezo ya utafiti na matokeo ya Linganisha yenye vyanzo vinavyoweza kuhusishwa
Uhusishaji ndicho kinachofanya utafiti utumike tena. Hitimisho bila chanzo ni maoni; Linganisha bila sababu iliyorekodiwa ni sarafu usiyoweza kuikagua tena.
treehouse.lesson.house-connections.tasks:
Katika hati, ongeza kazi ya kisanduku cha kuangalia na uifungue katika [Meatbag Tasks](clank://tasks). Kamilisha kazi na ufungue upya hati ya chanzo. Kwa upande mwingine, tengeneza tukio la [Timeline](clank://timeline) kwenye mazoezi ya mazoezi na usoge hadi tarehe tofauti.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** kisanduku cha chanzo hubadilika kutoka kisichokaguliwa hadi kimekaguliwa, na tukio la Timeline huhifadhiwa kisha husogea huku tukishikilia utambulisho ule ule thabiti wa tukio.

Kazi inaweza kuelekeza kwenye hati ya chanzo. Kuikamilisha hubadilisha kisanduku kilichorejelewa katika hati hiyo kutoka kisichokaguliwa hadi kimekaguliwa — dokezo na kazi hubaki kazi moja. [Timeline](clank://timeline) hushikilia matukio yenye tarehe kwenye nyimbo; tukio linaweza kusogezwa hadi tarehe au mstari tofauti halali na kuishikilia utambulisho wake.
Futa dokezo la mazoezi na tukio lake la Timeline ukimaliza.
Kisanduku cha chanzo kimewekwa alama na kazi, na tukio husogea hadi tarehe/mstari mpya.
Kazi moja ya kisanduku cha kuangalia katika dokezo la mazoezi, na tukio moja la siku moja kwenye mstari wa mazoezi.
Kazi ya chanzo na kuingia kwa timeline
Kazi inayoweka alama kisanduku halisi cha kuangalia katika hati yake ya chanzo, na tukio la Timeline ulilolisogeza.
Kazi zenye chanzo na maingizo ya Timeline
Kazi inayoelekeza chanzo chake ni kazi unayoweza kuikagua. Na timeline unayoweza kuibadilisha ndivyo mpangilio unavyopata uhusiano na uhalisi bila kupoteza historia yake.
treehouse.lesson.house-documents.images-:
Tayarisha picha katika [Files](clank://files) na uingize katika hati katika [Editor](clank://editor). Hifadhi, pakia upya, na uthibitisho picha bado inafikika. Kisha sogeza hati hadi folda nyingine na uthibitisho marejeo yamebaki yamefanana.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** utayarishaji wa picha ya ubao wa kunakili na uingizaji wa hati huhifadhiwa pamoja, na mali iliyomilikiwa iko mahali pa media inapohitajika.

Picha hukaa katika [Files](clank://files) na huingizwa katika hati kupitia kibadilishaji kimoja cha kiambatisho. Hati huishikilia marejeo halisi ya mali: sogeza hati na marejeo yanayojulikana hukaguliwa, si kuachwa yakiwa yamefungwa. Mali za Gallery ni mali za Files — hakuna gallery tofauti ya kusimamia.
Futa hati ya mazoezi na mali yake ya picha inayomilikiwa ukimaliza.
Picha hufikika kutoka kwa mali yake ya Files baada ya kupakia upya na baada ya kusogeza hati.
Ingiza picha ndogo moja katika hati ya mazoezi na uhifadhi.
Picha iliyoingizwa katika hati ambayo bado hufikia mali yake ya Files baada ya kupakia upya.
Picha na viungo vinavyobaki vimeambatishwa kwenye chanzo chake
Viambatisho vinavyopitia kupakia upya na kusogeza ndivyo vinavyofanya hati iwe ya kusafirisha. Picha inayotokea pale folda inapobadilika ni hati iliyovunjika.
treehouse.lesson.house-documents.new-doc:
Fungua [Editor](clank://editor) na uunde hati mpya. Tumia kiingizi cha sehemu ya kiolezo kuongeza sehemu moja iliyotolewa. Hariri maandishi yaliyoingizwa na uhifadhi.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** hati hufunguka upya na maandishi yako ya sehemu yaliyohaririwa na alama ya marekebisho imeongezeka. Kiolezo mwenyewe hakijabadilika.

Unda hati katika [Editor](clank://editor). Violezo huhifadhiwa katika [Mipangilio](clank://settings) na kuingiza moja kunanakili mali na sehemu zake katika hati unayoandika. Kuingiza kunamaanisha kunakili: kuhariri sehemu iliyoweza kubadilika hauhariri kiolezo kamwe.
Futa hati hii ya mazoezi ukimaliza, au uiache — ni maudhui ya kawaida.
Hati hufunguka upya na sehemu iliyohaririwa na alama mpya ya marekebisho.
Tengeneza hati na uingize sehemu moja ya kiolezo; badilisha mstari mmoja na uhifadhi.
Dokezo la mazoezi lenye msingi wa kiolezo
Hati iliyoundwa kutoka kwa sehemu ya kiolezo, tayari kuhaririwa.
Hati mpya na sehemu za kiolezo zinazoingizwa

Violezo hugeuza muundo unaotumia tena — umbo la mkutano, orodha ya ukaguzi, mfumo wa utafiti — kuwa kitu unachoweza kuweka bila kuandika upya. Kwa sababu kuingiza kunanakili, mabadiliko yako hubaki yako.
treehouse.lesson.house-documents.rich-ma:
Fungua hati inayoshikilia lugha ya programu inayotumika yenye maoni au matini ya maelezo. Ionyeshe kwa utajiri, kisha tumia **Tazama chanzo** kwenye Onyesho Rasmi la Upangaji wa Markdown ili kukagua mistari ya chanzo nyuma ya kizuizi, na urudi na **Rudi kwenye iliyochorwa**.

**Matokeo yanayoonekana:** eneo la maoni au matini ya maelezo linalotumika linaonyeshwa kama Markdown isiyotupu na hifadhi dhidi ya marekebisho ya chanzo. Kikaguzi cha kufichua chanzo ni kipengele cha onyesho la upangaji; hati za kawaida huishikilia chanzo chake kama rekodi pekee.

Editor huonyesha Markdown kwa utajiri, ikijumuisha eneo la maoni na matini ya maelezo ndani ya chanzo cha programu. # Mwongozo wa Open Clank

Karibu. Huu ndio mwongozo unaodhibitiwa unaotolewa na Open Clank. Ni wa kusoma tu: tumia **Tengeneza nakala inayoweza kuhaririwa** kwenye ukurasa wowote ili kuishikilia madokezo yako kando yake. Masasisho hubadilisha kurasa hizi mahali pamoja na haguswi nakala zako binafsi kamwe.

## Anza hapa

- [[Kukamilisha Kazi]] — umbo la kikao cha kawaida
- [[Editor]] — hati, kurasa za Wiki, violezo na media
- [[Faili na Imps]] — mti wa faili na miradi ya picha inayosimamiwa
- [[Graph]] — jinsi hati zako zinavyoungana

## Akaunti yako na zana

- [[Akaunti na Modeli]] — utambulisho, watoa huduma na uteuzi wa modeli
- [[Gumzo na Nafasi za Kazi]] — mazungumzo, rasimu na muktadha
- [[Kazi na Kuendelea]] — kugeuza madokezo kuwa uendelezaji

## Sehemu nyingine ya mwongozo

- [[Kumbukumbu na Lore]] — msaidizi anachokumbuka na jinsi urejeshaji unavyofanya kazi
- [[Mipangilio na Mandhari]] — mwonekano, paneli na mapendeleo
- [[Urejeshaji]] — historia, nakala za chelezo na wakati vitu vinapokatika
- [[Mipaka na Usaidizi wa Jukwaa]] — mipaka halisi ya uwezo
- [[Onyesho la Upangaji la Markdown]] — kila kipengele kilichochorwa na chanzo chake

## Nenda mahali popote kwenye programu

Viungo hivi vinafungua skrini halisi. Havisaidii kufunga dirisha ulilofungua tayari wala kuanzisha gumzo kwa niaba yako.

- Fungua [Mipangilio](clank://settings) au ruka hadi [mwonekano](clank://settings/appearance)
- Vinjari [Faili](clank://files) au fungua [Graph](clank://graph)
- Endelea katika [Editor](clank://editor) au [maktaba ya Wiki](clank://wiki)
docs.openclank-docs-getting-work-done.bo:
# Kukamilisha Kazi

Open Clank ni nafasi ya kazi ya gumzo kwanza. Unazungumza na msaidizi wako katikati, na seti ya Copal — Editor, Faili, Graph, Timeline, TreeHouse na Kazi — hushikilia nyenzo za kudumu unazozalisha pamoja.

## Kikao cha kawaida

1. Anza au uendelee na gumzo. Kila mazungumzo huishikilia nakala yake na orodha yake ya kazi.
2. Omba kitu halisi. Msaidizi anaweza kusoma na kuandika hati zako za Copal, kuzindua zana, na kurejelea kile alichofanya baadaye.

Fungua [Editor](clank://editor) ili kuona hati, au [Gumzo](clank://chat) ili kurudi kwenye mazungumzo.

## Vitu vipo wapi

| Unataka | Nenda |
| --- | --- |
| Kuandika au kusoma hati ndefu | [Editor](clank://editor) |
| Kupanga kurasa za maarifa zilizounganishwa | [Maktaba ya Wiki](clank://wiki) |
| Kusimamia faili na picha | [Faili](clank://files) |
| Kuona jinsi hati zinavyoungana | [Graph](clank://graph) |
| Kufuatilia uendelezaji | [Kazi](clank://tasks) |
| Kubadilisha mwonekano au tabia | [Mipangilio](clank://settings) |

## Aina mbili za maudhui

**Binafsi** madokezo, nakala na maelezo ni yako. Badilisha majina, hariri, futa — msaidizi hayatayaandika upya tu kwa sababu jina linafanana.

**Rasmi** kama mwongozo huu ni za kusoma tu na kushirikiwa na kila akaunti kwenye usakinishaji huu. Hukaa katika folda ya `OpenClank/` na kusasishwa na bidhaa.

Unapotaka kubadilisha ukurasa rasmi, tengeneza nakala inayoweza kuhaririwa. Nakala yako ni yako tangu wakati huo.
docs.openclank-docs-accounts-models.body:
# Akaunti na Modeli

Open Clank ni ya akaunti nyingi. Kila akaunti inamiliki gumzo, hati, faili na mipangilio yake, hivyo watu wawili wanaweza kushiriki usakinishaji mmoja bila kuona kazi ya kila mmoja.

## Akaunti yako

Akaunti yako huchaguliwa wakati wa kuingia. Hati, kazi, kumbukumbu na mipangilio vimepewa mipaka ya akaunti hiyo. Ukiingia kama mtu mwingine unapata nafasi yao ya kazi, si yako — hakuna kinachounganishwa.

Usakinishaji wa ndani bila uthibitisho hupewa akaunti moja ya ndani. Hifadhi ya hati ya Copal bado imepewa mipaka kwa kila mmiliki ndani, hivyo kuwasha uthibitisho baadaye hachanganyi data iliyopo.

## Kuchagua modeli

Modeli husanidiwa katika [Mipangilio](clank://settings/providers). Mtoa huduma ni huduma inayoendesha modeli — mazingira ya ndani, au API ya mbali unayoleta ufunguo wake.\n
Mwongozo wa vitendo:

- Chagua modeli ndogo, ya haraka kwa maboresho ya haraka na muhtasari.
- Chagua modeli imara zaidi kwa hoja ndefu, msimbo au utafiti.
- Badilisha katikati ya mazungumzo kazi ikikua; nakala hushikilia vyote viwili.

Linganisha inapatikana kwa majibu ya bega kwa bega kutoka kwa modeli mbili kwenye amri ileile. Ni muhimu unapoamua modeli gani ya kuishikilia.

## Kile Open Clank isichofanya

- Haichagui modeli kwa ajili yako wala kubadilika kimyakimya kwa mtoa huduma mwingine bila kukuambia.
- Haitumi hati zako kwa mtoa huduma isipokuwa mwito wa zana au amri unapozihitaji.
- Haihifadhi funguo za API za mtoa huduma katika hati zako wala katika chanzo cha kwanza.

Angalia [[Mipaka na Usaidizi wa Jukwaa]] kwa kile kinachoendeshwa wapi.
docs.openclank-docs-chat-workspaces.body:
# Gumzo na Nafasi za Kazi

Gumzo ni uso wa mazungumzo. Copal ni uso wa hati. Vinashiriki akaunti moja na kikundi kimoja cha rasilimali, lakini vina sheria tofauti.

## Gumzo

Kila mazungumzo ni nakala yake yenye historia yake, viambatisho na orodha yake ya kazi. Unaweza kuwa na mazungumzo mengi wazi na kubadilisha kati yao kutoka upande wa pembeni.

Gumzo zinaweza kurejelea hati za Copal kwa jina. Msaidizi anaponukuu au kuunganisha hati, kufungua kiungo hicho kunaenda kwenye hati katika Editor — haigawanyi gumzo wala hupotezi rasimu yako.

## Nafasi za kazi na rasimu

Editor huishikilia rasimu. Ukiandika katika hati na kusogeza, rasimu huishikiliwa na kurejeshwa unaporudi. Kuhifadhi kumelindwa: toleo lililohifadhiwa likisogea chini yako, kuhifadhi hukataliwa badala ya kufuta kazi mpya kimyakimya.

Madirisha katika Copal (Editor, Graph, Timeline na mengine) huishikilia nafasi na uteuzi wao. Kufunga dirisha hakufuti chochote.

## Utambulisho katika viungo

Viungo vya hati hubeba utambulisho wa hati, si kichwa tu. Kubadilisha jina la hati huviacha viungo vikifanya kazi. Kushiriki kiungo na mtu kwenye akaunti nyingine ya usakinishaji uleule hutatuliwa ndani ya eneo lake — wanaona nakala yao ya lengo, si yako.

## Kulinda kazi yako

- Rasimu hupitia uchunguzi na usimamizi wa madirisha.
- Kujibu arifa ya kazi huendelea katika gumzo lake la kazi asilia, si gumzo lolote lililo mbele.
- Hakuna katika gumzo kinachohariri hati ya Copal bila kupitia uhifadhi wa kawaida uliolindwa.

Endelea na [[Editor]] au [[Kazi na Kuendelea]].
docs.openclank-docs-editor.body.compat-7:
# Editor

Editor ni nafasi ya kazi ya hati iliyoshirikiwa. Kurasa za Markdown, kurasa za Wiki, madokezo yaliyopewa aina, Bases, Canvas, jedwali na media vyote hufunguka hapa kama majani yaliyopewa aina yenye vichupo na migawanyiko.

## Kurasa na vichupo

Fungua hati kutoka kwa mti wa faili au kiungo. Tumia vichupo kwa kusoma sambamba, na migawanyiko kwa kazi ya bega kwa bega. Nia ya uchunguzi heshimiwa: kubofya kawaida hufungua katika kichupo cha sasa, Command/Control-kubofya hufungua kichupo kipya, na menyu ya muktadha hutoa mgawanyiko wa kulia au mgawanyiko chini.

Viungo kati ya hati huendesha kichupo ulicho ndani. Uchunguzi wa wazi wa kichupo kipya hubaki wazi — hakuna kinachochukua mwonekano wako wa sasa.

## Kurasa za Wiki

Wiki ni aina ya ukurasa ndani ya Editor, si programu tofauti. Maktaba ya Wiki huorodhesha kurasa zako za maarifa na inaweza kuzitengeneza, kuzihamisha na kuzileta kama faili za `.memes`. Kufungua ukurasa hukupa mwonekano wa makala na viungo, viungo vya nyuma na maelezo — vichupo, migawanyiko na umiliki wa uhifadhi yale yale kama hati nyingine yoyote.

Viungo vya Wiki vinafanana na `[[Ukurasa Fulani]]`. Lengo lililopo hufunguka kwa kubofya; lengo linalokosekana linaonyeshwa kama viungo vilivyovunjika unavyoweza kuvitengeneza. Viungo vya nyuma kwenye ukurasa huorodhesha kila ukurasa unaoelekeza hapo.

Angalia [maktaba ya Wiki](clank://wiki) au fungua [Editor](clank://editor).

## Violezo

Violezo hukaa katika folda unayoichagua katika
[Mipangilio](clank://settings). Kuingiza kiolezo kunanakili mali na viungo vyake katika hati ya sasa na kuishikilia utambulisho wa rasilimali, hivyo viambatisho hubaki vimeambatishwa.

## Maoni ya chanzo

Maoni tajiri ya chanzo huambatanisha maoni kwenye kipande cha chanzo cha hati. Husafiri pamoja na hati na kupitia mabadiliko nje ya kipande. Maoni ni sehemu ya rekodi ya hati, si hifadhi tofauti ya juu.

## Media na viambatisho

Picha, sauti, video na PDF zinaweza kuambatishwa kwenye hati au kurejelewa kwa njia. Media ilizotumika huchorwa ndani katika mwonekano wa Markdown. Faili zilizoambatishwa hufanywa na hati na husogea nayo.

[[Onyesho la Upangaji la Markdown]] linaonyesha kila kipengele cha upangaji kisaidizi hiki hiki, na chanzo chake ghafi kwa kubofya mara moja.

docs.openclank-docs-files-imps.body.comp:
# Faili na Imps

Faili ni mti wa faili wa akaunti yako: hati, folda, media na miradi ya picha inayosimamiwa Imps inayozalisha.

## Mti wa faili

Fungua [Faili](clank://files) ili kuvinjari. Faili na Editor hushiriki utambulisho mmoja wa rasilimali: hati iliyofunguliwa kutoka Faili ni hati ile ile, yenye rasimu na historia ile ile. Kusogeza hati huviacha viungo na viambatisho vyake.

Faili huonyesha uwezo kwa uwazi — kusoma, kuhariri, kuandika — hivyo rasilimali ya kusoma tu inasema hivyo badala ya kushindwa baadaye wakati wa kuhifadhi.

## Miradi ya Imps inayosimamiwa

Imps ni mhariri wa picha. Miradi yake ni rekodi zinazosimamiwa: kila uhifadhi hukamata picha ya awali ya urejeshaji kwanza, na uhifadhi hukataliwa ukaguzi huo ukishindwa. Unaweza kubatilisha uhifadhi kwa kurejesha picha ya awali iliyokamatwa.\n
Njia za mwisho za mradi hukaa chini ya `/api/imps/projects/*`. Mradi hufungwa na rasilimali ya picha ya mtoa huduma na kuishikilia hesabu yake ya marekebisho hivyo uhifadhi wa sambamba hauwezi kufuta kila mmoja kimyakimya.

## Galeria

Programu ndogo ya Galeria iliyotenganishwa imeachishwa. Maudhui ya picha sasa hukaa katika folda ya **Picha** chini ya Faili. Viungo vya zamani vya `gallery:` hutatuliwa kwa Faili, na uhariri wa picha hufungua mhariri wa Imps. Usimamizi wa albamu umeondoka pamoja na programu ndogo; folda ni folda ya kawaida unayoweza kusogeza na kubadilisha jina.

Fungua [Faili](clank://files) ili kuona Picha.

## Media katika hati

Media iliyoambatishwa kwenye hati huhifadhiwa pamoja na hati na husogea nayo. Kuingiza picha katika Markdown huionyesha ndani; kuingiza PDF huonyesha kichunguzi; sauti na video huonyesha kichezaji chao.

Angalia [[Editor]] kwa kuambatanisha media kwenye hati.
docs.openclank-docs-graph.body.compat-9f:
# Graph

Graph inaonyesha jinsi hati zako zinavyoungana: viungo vya Wiki, kuingizwa, lebo na uhusiano waliopewa aina vyote hufanywa kuwa uhusiano. Hali ya Galaxy hupanga hati na matukio ya kalenda pamoja; hali ya muundo hugeuza vichwa na vidokezo vya hati kuwa muhtasari unaoweza kuchunguzwa.

Fungua [Graph](clank://graph) au ruka hadi [Galaxy](clank://galaxy).

## Unachoona

Nodi ni hati. Uhusiano ni uhusiano — kiungo, kuingizwa, uanachama wa lebo au uhusiano uliopewa aina kutoka kwa sifa za dokezo. Kubofya nodi hufungua hati hiyo katika Editor.

## Vichujio

Paneli ya kichujio hupunguza kwa aina, folda, lebo na thamani ya sifa. Vipengele hutoka kwa metadata halisi ya hati, hivyo thamani ilipo kwenye hati ambado hujapakia bado inapatikana — orodha ya vipengele hupitia seva hadi imeona kila kitu.

Machaguo tupu hupunguza matokeo; kuondoa kichujio hukifungua tena.

## Nyaraka rasmi katika Graph

Mwongozo huu ni nyaraka zilizotolewa. Graph huficha nyaraka zilizotolewa kwa chaguo-msingi ili madokezo yako binafsi yakuwe ya kwanza kuonekana. Washa **Jumuisha nyaraka rasmi** ili kuzirudisha, au bofya chipu ya folda ya `OpenClank` ili kujumuisha folda hiyo tu.

Kuficha kunaegemea metadata halisi ya utambulisho — alama ya bidhaa iliyotolewa — si jina la folda. Madokezo yako mwenyewe katika folda yoyote, ikiwa ni pamoja na `OpenClank/`, hayafichwi kamwe kwa sababu ya mahali pako.

## Hali ya muundo

Kwa hati moja, hali ya muundo huorodhesha vichwa na vidokezo na kukuruhusu kupanga upya sehemu. Ni zana sahihi kwa kubadilisha umbo la ukurasa mrefu; [[Editor]] ni zana sahihi kwa kuandika upya mmoja.
docs.openclank-docs-memory-lore.body.com:
# Kumbukumbu na Lore

Open Clank ina mifumo miwili ya kumbukumbu inayohusika lakini tofauti. **Kumbukumbu** (uso wa Ubongo) ni kile msaidizi anakumbuka kati ya vipindi. **Lore** ni daftari la urejeshaji linaloruhusu kazi kubatilishwa na kujengwa upya.

## Kumbukumbu

Uvunaji wa kumbukumbu ni wa hiari na kwa kila akaunti. Ukiwashwa, msaidizi anaweza kuhifadhi ukumbusho mfupi ambao vipindi vya baadaye vinaweza kutumia. Unaweza kukagua, kuhariri na kufuta kumbukumbu zilizohifadhiwa kutoka [Mipangilio](clank://settings) chini ya Ubongo.

Kumbukumbu haibadilishi hati zako kamwe. Ni ukumbusho, si hifadhi — rekodi rasmi ya kazi yako ni Copal na nakala ya gumzo.

## Lore

Lore ni picha ya awali ya kudumu na daftari la vitendo nyuma ya shughuli zinazoweza kurejeshwa. Uhifadhi uliodhibitiwa unapotokea — uhifadhi wa mradi wa Imps, kuhifadhi hati kulikolindwa — hali ya awali hukamatwa kwanza. Ukaguzi ukishindwa, uhifadhi hukataliwa badala ya kuacha shimo lisilorejeshwa.

Haingiliani na Lore moja kwa moja. Unaiona katika Historia na katika vitufe vya kubatilisha/kurejesha vinavyotegemea.

## Historia

Historia ya hati huorodhesha alama za ukaguzi na mabadiliko kwa hati moja. Kutoka hapo unaweza kukagua toleo la awali na kulirejesha. Historia imepewa mipaka ya hati na akaunti.

Angalia [Mipangilio](clank://settings/history) kwa bajeti za uwekaji.

## Kile ambacho kumbukumbu siyo

- Si faharisi ya utafutaji juu ya kila kitu ulichowahi kuandika.
- Haishirikiwi kati ya akaunti.
- Si mbadala wa kuhifadhi unayojali.

[[Urejeshaji]] unashughulikia cha kufanya kitu kinapokatika.
docs.openclank-docs-tasks.body.compat-0e:
# Kazi na Kuendelea

Kazi ni vipengele vya kudumu vya uendelezaji. Ni daraja kati ya "msaidizi alisema atafanya X" na "X ilitokea kweli, na hapa ndipo ilipo."

## Gumzo za kazi

Kila kazi huishikilia gumzo moja la kudumu. Kufungua kazi kutoka kwa arifa, beji au orodha ya kazi hufungua gumzo hilo — lile la asilia — si gumzo lolote lililo mbele. Kujibu swali katika arifa huendelea na gumzo la kazi bila kuchukua gumzo lako la mbele.

Fungua [Meatbag Tasks](clank://tasks) kwa orodha kamili, au [mwonekano wa kazi](clank://tasks)
ndani ya Copal.

## Vyanzo

Kazi zinaweza kutoka kwa gumzo, kutoka kwa kisanduku cha kuangalia katika hati, au kutoka kwa uendeshaji uliopangwa. Kazi ya kisanduku cha kuangalia katika hati hubeba utambulisho wa hati, hivyo kazi na mstari uliotoka humo hubaki zimeunganishwa.

## Kuendelea

Kuendelea ni uendeshaji ulioendelezwa wa gumzo la kazi lile lile. Muktadha hukusanyika katika nakala ya kazi hiyo badali ya kuenea kwenye mazungumzo mapya. Kazi ikikamilika, gumzo lake hubaki kama rekodi ya kilichotokea.

## Tabia za vitendo

- Mwambie msaidizi atengeneze kazi kazi itakapodumu zaidi ya mazungumzo ya sasa.
- Ishikilie kazi moja kwa kila matokeo; gumzo chini yake lina undani.
- Tumia visanduku vya kuangalia katika hati kwa kazi inayohusika na hati hiyo.

Ifuatayo: [[Kumbukumbu na Lore]] kwa kinachopitia kuanzisha upya, au [[Urejeshaji]] kwa
cha kufanya uendeshaji ukikatika.
docs.openclank-docs-settings-themes.body:
# Mipangilio na Mandhari

Mipangilio inamiliki usanidi na mwonekano. Mandhari hukaa hapa — hakuna programu ndogo tofauti ya mandhari.

Fungua [Mipangilio](clank://settings).

## Paneli

| Paneli | Kinachoshikilia |
| --- | --- |
| [Mwonekano](clank://settings/appearance) | Mandhari, rangi, athari za mandharinyuma |
| [Watoa Huduma](clank://settings/providers) | Watoa huduma wa modeli na funguo |
| [Historia](clank://settings/history) | Kumbukumbu na bajeti za uwekaji |
| [Upatikanaji wa faili](clank://settings/file-access) | Msaidizi anaweza kugusa nini |

Paneli za mipangilio hufikiwa kwa uchunguzi wa moja kwa moja. Kufungua paneli kutoka kiungo huilenga; haifungi dirisha ulilokuwa nalo tayari.

## Mandhari

Mandhari hubadilisha rangi, mandharinyuma na athari kote kwenye gamba. Kichagua cha mandhari kinaonyesha hakiki za moja kwa moja. Rangi maalum za msisitizo zinapatikana kwenye kila mandhari, na unaweza kuhifadhi mandhari yako mwenyewe yaliyopewa jina (hadi nane) na kushiriki kama JSON.

Mandharinyuma / Athari huuchagua mtindo wa mapambo. Athari zilizotolewa ni: Imara, Njia za Ishara za Clanker, Ufumaji wa Ishara Unaovutiwa na Shipibo Kene, Clanker LCARS, Clanker Gem Drift, Clanker Emoji Drift, Clanker Matrix Rain, Clanker Emoji Rain, Clanker LCARS Status Sweep, Nukta, Synapse, Mvua, Mapambo, Mtiririko wa Perlin, Vipepeo, Miale na Makaa. Kila athari inayosaidia huonyesha rangi ya athari, kuteleza kwa Ukubwa na kuteleza kwa Ukubwa; athari bila udhibiti huo huzificha.

Athari za mandharinyuma ni mapambo. Kwenye mashine ambapo athari ni nzito sana inaweza kuzimwa bila kubadilisha sehemu nyingine za mandhari.

## Uandishi na upatikanaji

Mwonekano pia hudhibiti uandishi: uteuzi wa herufi, mpangilio wa unene (starehe, imara, mpana) na kipimo cha ukubwa wa maandishi ya UI ambacho ni huru kutoka kwa mandhari hai. Kigeuza cha kioo kilichopooza hupooza paneli ambapo mandhari yanayosaidia. Hivi ni vidhibiti vya usomaji, si mapambo.

## Kile mipangilio isichofanya

- Haihamishi hati zako.
- Haibadilishi mipangilio ya akaunti nyingine.
- Haihitaji kuanzisha upya kwa mabadiliko ya mwonekano.

[[Akaunti na Modeli]] inashughulikia usanidi wa mtoa huduma kwa undani zaidi.
docs.openclank-docs-recovery.body.compat:
# Urejeshaji

Mara nyingi hakuna kinachokatika. Kikitokea, ukurasa huu ndio ramani.

## Uhifadhi ulikataliwa

Uhifadhi uliolindwa hukataa kufuta kazi mpya. Fungua hati tena na uunganishe — toleo ulilokuwa ukihaririwa bado lipo kwenye akiba yako ya rasimu, na toleo lililohifadhiwa liko salama.

## Hati inaonekana si sahihi

Hati ikionyesha paneli ya urejeshaji badala ya maudhui yake, baiti zilizohifadhiwa haziwezi kusimbuliwa. Chanzo asilia kimehifadhiwa. Tumia paneli ya urejeshaji kuchagua chanzo kilichohifadhiwa, au rejesha kutoka kwa historia.

Hakuna kinachohariri hati iliyoshindwa kusimbuliwa kimyakimya.

## Kubatilisha uhifadhi uliodhibitiwa

Uhifadhi wa mradi wa Imps hukamata picha ya awali kwanza. Rejesha kutoka kwa historia ya mradi ili kucheza picha hiyo ya awali na kubatilisha uhifadhi.

## Kurejesha toleo la hati

Historia ya hati huorodhesha alama za ukaguzi. Chagua toleo na ulirejesha. Kurejesha mwenyewe kunaandikwa, hivyo unaweza kurudi mbele tena.

## Kuanza upya kwenye kurasa rasmi

Kurasa rasmi za mwongozo kama hii ni za kusoma tu na kusasishwa na bidhaa. Ukitengeneza nakala inayoweza kuhaririwa na unataka asili mpya, futa nakala yako na ufungue upya ukurasa rasmi — asili bado iko.

## Wakati wa kuomba msaada

- Kazi iliyopangwa ilikimbia lakini haikutoa chochote: gumzo lake la kazi lina nakala.
- Faili zimepotea: angalia [Faili](clank://files) marufuku kabla hujadhania kupotea.
- Mipangilio inaonekana si sahihi: paneli za [Mipangilio](clank://settings) ni kwa kila akaunti.

Angalia [[Kumbukumbu na Lore]] kwa upande wa historia na uwekaji.
docs.openclank-docs-limits.body.compat-2:
# Mipaka na Usaidizi wa Jukwaa

Mipaka halisi ni sehemu ya mwongozo. Ukurasa huu ndipo wanapokaa.

## Miundo ya data

**JSON kamili haina maoni.** Lolote lililohifadhiwa kama JSON kamili — usanidi, faili za mradi, vifurushi vya kubadilishana — hakiwezi kubeba maoni ya kueleza. Tumia ukurasa wa Markdown au sifa ya hati unapohitaji kuelezea data.

**Madokezo ya asili yamepangwa.** Ukurasa wa shajara ni mti wa hati wenye vizuizi, sifa na uhusiano uliopewa aina, si faili tupu ya `.md`. Markdown ni njia ya kubadilishana na makadirio ya uhariri; rekodi iliyohifadhiwa ni tajiri zaidi.

## Usaidizi wa jukwaa

Open Clank hukimbia asili kwenye macOS, Windows na Linux. Modeli za ndani zilizoharakishwa na GPU hutegemea jukwaa:

- macOS: Metal kupitia mazingira ya ndani. Modeli za MLX pekee haziwezi kutumika.
- Windows: kizinduzi cha asili hufunga loopback kwa chaguo-msingi; kufichua LAN ni kwa hiari.
- Linux: vifurushi vya asili; usaidizi wa GPU hutegemea safu ya madereva iliyosakinishwa.

Usambazaji wa chombo umeelezwa kwa seva lakini si uzoefu wa desktop na si kile nyaraka hizi za desktop zinavyohusika.

## Kipimo cha kisaidizi

Kisaidizi cha Markdown si kamili cha CommonMark. Kinaunga mkono vichwa, usisitizo, alama, msimbo wa ndani, msimbo uliofungwa, orodha, orodha za kazi, nukuu, wagawanyaji, jedwali, viungo vya Wiki, viungo vya kawaida, viungo vya programu na media ilizotumika. Miundo ya kigeni hupita kama maandishi halisi badala ya kuharibika.

Kikaguzi cha kufichua chanzo cha upangaji kipo kwa
[[Onyesho la Upangaji la Markdown]] pekee. Kurasa za kawaida za nyaraka hubaki zikiwa zimechorwa.

## Kile ambacho hakidaiwi hapa

- Hakuna tovuti ya nyaraka za wavuti au za umma inayoanzishwa na mwongozo huu.
- Hakuna kushiriki hati kati ya akaunti.
- Hakuna uhamishaji wa kiotomatiki wa faili binafsi kwenda Copal.

Kitu chochote kwenye ukurasa huu kikikosekana kulingana na bidhaa inayoendeshwa, bidhaa inayoendeshwa ni sahihi na ukurasa huu utasasishwa nayo.
